P3.7: Persistence wire-in shipped. New `src/trade_intel/persistence/` package with `ingest.py` exporting `ingest_messages(messages, *, session, source_type, group_name=None, source_path=None, dedup_set=None) -> IngestStats`. Persists `ParsedMessage` stream into groups/sellers/buyers/messages/inventory/demand. Pipeline per OK message: (1) status filter — SYSTEM/MEDIA/MALFORMED/ORPHAN_CONTINUATION counted-and-dropped via `IngestStats._skipped_status_field` dispatch; (2) hash dedup against in-memory `DedupSet` (preloaded from `messages.hash` if caller didn't pass one — P3.4 hand-off realized); (3) classify intent + extract products from `normalized_message`; (4) identity merge (D-009) — `_get_or_create_seller`/`_get_or_create_buyer` route by intent (SELLER vs BUYER), phone-first (`Seller.phone == phone`), canonical-name + NULL-phone fallback so same-name+different-person don't collide; on merge, `post_count`/`request_count` incremented, `first_seen`/`last_seen` widened, `aliases` set-unioned + sorted; BROKER/UNKNOWN store the message but touch no side table; (5) insert Message with `group_id`/`sender_name`/`sender_phone`/`raw_text`/`message_ts`/`intent`/`intent_confidence`/`hash`/`buyer_id`/`seller_id`; (6) one Inventory row per product on SELLER, one Demand row per product on BUYER (with urgency from IntentResult).
